reason: Complete hierarchy plus general/faction compatibility and absolute cannot unless explicit override.

question.question: Which rules take precedence among cards, Law, Learning to Play and faction rules, and can an ordinary card override a cannot?

expected.expected_answer: Card beats Law; Law beats Learning to Play. Follow both general and faction when possible, otherwise faction wins. Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden.

source_passages.quotation: - **Precedence:** Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play. Follow general and faction rules together when possible; if incompatible, faction rule wins. **Cannot is absolute** unless explicitly overridden. (1.1.)

answer.ruling: Cards override the Law, and the Law overrides Learning to Play. Apply general and faction rules together when possible; if incompatible, the faction rule wins.
“Cannot” is absolute unless explicitly overridden. An ordinary card can override a cannot only when it explicitly does so; otherwise the prohibition remains.
